summary: Completed comprehensive testing of two new features: (1) RESTORE DELETED PRODUCTS - owner can restore permanently deleted products from audit log with same ID, stock, and history reconnection; admin blocked (403). (2) SYNC KG ALL - owner can sync all out-of-sync whole chicken products at once; admin blocked (403). Both features fully functional in backend and frontend with correct RBAC enforcement.
